subject: Judi Harrington Memoir Fuckery
overview: Medford Bytes interviewed author and writing coach Judi Harrington about her self-published memoir, "Fuckery: The Life and Times of a Legend in Her Own Mind." Harrington discussed family stories, parenting experiences, and an upcoming author reading at the Medford Public Library.

items.title: Guest Introduction and Favorite Medford Restaurants
items.summary: Author Judi Harrington introduces herself and shares her favorite Medford dining spots, including Saybar and The Ford.

items.title: Overview and Writing of Memoir Fuckery
items.summary: Harrington discusses her memoir, "Fuckery: The Life and Times of a Legend in Her Own Mind," explaining how she compiled family stories and navigated self-publishing.

items.title: Book Purchasing Options
items.summary: Harrington explains where to buy her book and encourages supporting independent bookstores through Bookshop.org.

items.title: Parenting and Family Anecdotes
items.summary: The hosts and Harrington discuss memoir anecdotes regarding parenting, fake birthdays, and supporting children through name and pronoun changes.

items.title: Upcoming Library Event and Medford Community
items.summary: Harrington announces a January 26 reading at the Medford Public Library and expresses gratitude for community programs like the Medford Family Network.
